canonical_title: Escape exits and routes – multi-place and cargo air vehicles
subject_group: 9.6.3 Emergency ground, ditching, and water egress

versions.title_at_revision: Escape exits and routes – multi-place and cargo air vehicles
versions.text:
Standard: Multi-place and cargo air vehicle exits and sizes have twice the capacity for the maximum number of crewmembers to egress in the specified time. The occupied areas allow for complete abandonment within the required time during ground emergency egress or ditching of the air vehicle with the landing gear extended as well as retracted. Egress times are as follows: a. For overwater transport air vehicles, all crewmembers can egress within 30 seconds using only half the exits under day and night lighting conditions. b. For all other multi-place and cargo air vehicle configurations, except for air vehicles with overwater missions, all crewmembers can egress within 60 seconds using only half the exits under day and night lighting conditions. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Analyze the air vehicle design and show that crewmembers can egress the air vehicle from the combination of a selection of half the exits which results in the most restrictive air vehicle configuration. The analysis includes crewmembers and passengers from across the intended anthropometric range.
(2) Analysis shows that egress is not impeded with landing gear retracted. Test.
  (1) Ground or Lab test: Tests from the air vehicle or high-fidelity mockup show that the equipped crewmembers and passengers can egress the air vehicle from that combination of a selection of half the exits which results in the most restrictive configuration. Tests include participants representative of the intended anthropometric range. The test includes both day and night conditions. The air vehicle or high-fidelity mockup is configured to include representative cargo and unstowed equipment.
